text:
Go, false vision, do not torment me;
leave me be, I do not wish to believe you.
My fortune lies in not finding out;
you would have me know, and everyone else too.

Go, cowardly fear, and tell me nothing
that does not accord with my faith;
go, mad suspicion; this is my fate:
to be slain by a thousand seeming shadows.

Go, hellish fire, jealous fury,
fierce imagination, cruel and harmful;
do not disabuse me when I ask you not to.

Believing in happiness wrongs no one.
Why would you make my lady seem so suspect,
and inflict this strange evil on me?

translation.title: Go, False Vision, Do Not Torment Me
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
